title: A Password on Paper
story: Dad's tablet would not open because he forgot the password. A paper copy was in the kitchen drawer. Nina found it, but the last two letters were missing. They tried an old code and then a newer one. The second try worked. Dad changed the password and stored the new code in a locked note on his phone. He thanked Nina and threw the paper away.
